title: Ruby
html_source:
Bloom looks at Molly’s copy on the bed in Chapter 4 when he brings up her breakfast.

“He turned over the smudged pages. RUBY: THE PRIDE OF THE RING. Hello. Illustration. Fierce Italian with carriagewhip. Must be Ruby pride of the on the floor naked.”
